sloka: अहो सुरमणीयो अयम् देशः शत्रु निषूदन ।दृढम् रंस्याव सौमित्रे साधु अत्र निवसावहे ॥४-२७-२५॥
transliteration: aho suramaṇīyo ayam deśaḥ śatru niṣūdana ।dṛḍham raṁsyāva saumitre sādhu atra nivasāvahe ॥4-27-25॥

translations.english: 'O Saumitri destroyer of enemies this place is most enchanting. Surely we will reside here sporting in joy .
